Jiangsu: Room 1008, Pingguo Dushi, 228 Tianyuan East Road, Jiangning, Nanjing; +86 186 0102 4019 / +86 137 0153 5216. Shanxi: 1 Dingyang Road, Yuci district, as printed; +86 158 0113 6435. Swedish hotel: Stavsjo, Nykoping; +46 (0)11 393150. Branch details are historical source entries; reconfirm before visiting.
